newsitem.title: GREECE: 7th coupon on EIB 5-yr drachma FRN set at 12.68pct.
newsitem.headline: 7th coupon on EIB 5-yr drachma FRN set at 12.68pct.

text.p: The 7th coupon for the period September 16 to December 15 on the EIB 5-year drachma floating rate note was set at 12.68 percent, agent bank Bayerische Vereinsbank AG, Athens branch said in a statement.
The coupon is based on three-month Athibor minus 40 basis points. The FRN was issued on March 15, 1995. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
